content: Oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃ.Orgyen Rinpoche, protector and refuge of wandering beings,Together with the assembly of vidyādharas and ḍākinīs,We pray to you with single-pointed devotion.Just as you promised, look upon us with love from the basic space of phenomena,And behold these weary beings with your compassion!I pray to you, Orgyen Rinpoche!Avert misfortune, O hosts of mothers and ḍākinīs!Pacify all the decline of these discordant times,And cause the prosperity of the outer environment and inner inhabitants to flourish.May conflicts, epidemics, earthquakes, insect infestations, and the like—And the malevolent intentions and actions of those with and without form,Be pacified, I pray!May the teachings flourish and the lives of the holders of the teachings be firm,And may the world be filled with the glory of happiness and well-being!Thus, this prayer for the well-being of the realm was written by the glorious Karmapa. Virtue! Virtue! Virtue!
